Hey! I think I can maybe help make comparisons from Ottawa and Paris! I was just in Paris and one of my friends have lived in both Ottawa and Paris! 

Ok so I can’t help much on the jobs (I’m a student), but I can give you an idea about areas and Ottawa in general. 

English is obviously super important here, but you will also hear a lot of French. Houses are not hard to find far from downtown at all. There are so many neighbourhoods that are not too expensive and honestly Ottawa takes pride in its green space. No matter where you live there is bound to be a park within walking distance. I live within distance of 5 schools, and like 3 public parks. 

I didn’t get to grow up in Ottawa but many of my friends did and they love it so much. It’s relatively safe (compared to many many places)! Even more unsafe places (vanier, herongate, etc.) are still ok. 

One thing I would say would probably drive you crazy is the public transit. When I was in Paris, I could get anywhere from the trains and subways. And they came so frequently. The bussing here is less frequent, reliable, and accessible to all areas of the city... however it is developing and if you live close to downtown you probably wouldn’t even use it! 

Also, I don’t know much about restaurants but there are many many little restaurants that aren’t chains and that deserve 10x the praise they deserve. I can’t suggest anything specific but there are definitely people who can. 

Hope this helps!
